## Catfolk Sneak (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
Female catfolk ranger (urban ranger) 3  
CG Medium humanoid (catfolk)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +3 Dex)  
**hp** 39 (3d10+9)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +6, **Will** +1  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** mwk kukri +7 (1d4+3/18-20) or mwk kukris +5/+5 (1d4+1/18–20)  
**Ranged** pepperbox pistol +6 (1d8/x4)  
**Special Attacks** combat style (two-weapon combat), favored enemy (klaven +2)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 12, **Dex** 17, **Con** 14, **Int** 10, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 17  
**Feats** Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (kukri)  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Climb +5, Disable Device +11, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (local) +6, Perception +8, Stealth +11, Survival +8; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Perception, +2 Stealth, +2 Survival  
**Languages** Catfolk, Common  
**SQ** cat’s luck, favored community (+2), sprinter, track +1, trapfinding +1, wild empathy +5  
**Combat Gear** potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of shield of faith; **Other Gear** +1 armored jacket, masterwork kukri (2), masterwork thieves’ tools, pepperbox pistol with 12 metal cartridges
